android.desc:
Step through a locked door. Then go back in time and unlock it before you get there. Time Travel Heist is a turn-based puzzle game where you are your own accomplice.

Every vault gives you a handful of turns and it is not enough for one pair of hands, so you step into a time portal, rewind to the moment you arrived, and live the same turns again as a second self. The first self is still there, doing what you told it to. It can unlock a door you have already walked through, or disarm the detector a moment before you walk into it, or carry the screwdriver back through the portal so that you are holding it before you pick it up.

Three portals means four selves, all working together at once, making the impossible possible. What you do in one moment reaches back and changes an earlier one.

1928. You pick up a radio signal from five centuries away: a resistance movement losing a war against the banks. The same banks you can see from your window, before they became megabanks. They want to fight them from the beginning, and for that they need someone in 1928. Who should you trust? And why will nobody tell you what happens in 1929?

More than 50 hand-built levels across nine chapters, from a single-room tutorial to vaults that can take you an evening.

• Turn-based — no timers, think at your own pace
• Step back and replay any move; no run is ever wasted
• Plays offline
• No ads, no in-app purchases
